description.value: The FireRock Lounge is a cozy upscale lounge inside the Westin Resort & Spa in Whistler Village, featuring a fireplace, two summer patios (one with mountain views, one a quiet courtyard), and creative small plates alongside BC wines, craft beers, and signature cocktails. It is part of the Gibbons Hospitality Group, a major operator of iconic Whistler Village venues. Touring cyclists finishing a mountain ride would find it a stylish spot to refuel with lunch, dinner, or après drinks in the heart of the village.
